Chapter 49: Chapter 46: Three Goddesses

Chapter 49: Chapter 46: Three Goddesses

Canglan Star, Shuiyue Residential Complex.

Residence number thirty-two.

Inside a nutrition pod, Lin Yuan opened his eyes.

Compared to the first traversal,

this traversal lasted much longer.

He had stayed in the Dragon Tiger World for a full eighty years.

Consider that before the second traversal,

...

including the first traversal,

his life in the Main World,

and his life on “Earth.”

All added together did not amount to eighty years.

However, it was all worth it.

Because Lin Yuan had created the Dao of Taiji.

You should know, at the level of a Heavenly Master,

The Heavenly Masters who break through by following the paths of either Taiyin Pole Extreme or Taiyang Pole Extreme,

are not the same concept as those who break through by following the Dao of Taiji.

Even without relying on either Taiyin Pole Extreme or Taiyang Pole Extreme,

with Lin Yuan’s Against-Heaven’s Understanding, he could force open a new route and break through to the Heavenly Master realm.

In the first ten years of the Dragon Tiger World, that’s what Lin Yuan did.

But in the end, he found that both in terms of potential and combat power, they did not compare to Taiyin Pole Extreme and Taiyang Pole Extreme.

And Taiyin Pole Extreme and Taiyang Pole Extreme, in turn, are far inferior to Taiji.

The Dao of Taiji is, up to now, the path most suitable for Lin Yuan and also the most perfect and powerful path he could achieve.

Perhaps in the many evolutionary paths of the Cosmic Human Alliance, there are paths stronger than the Dao of Taiji.

But definitely none as suitable for Lin Yuan as the Dao of Taiji.

How could the evolutionary paths initiated by others ever be as smooth as those one creates oneself?

“My current strength should be at the peak of the Second Layer twelve segments, infinitely approaching the Third Realm…”

Lin Yuan speculated in his heart.

In the Dragon Tiger World’s Demon Purge Cycle, it only took Lin Yuan forty years to advance from the Second Layer ninth segment to the twelfth segment.

The remaining twenty years, then, were spent exploring the subsequent Third Layer path.

Forty years to advance three segments; looking at Canglan Star, this might be considered top-tier.

But if considered within the entire Cosmic Human Alliance, it could only be regarded as above average.

But don’t forget, every step Lin Yuan took was path-creating.

Creating a completely new evolutionary path from scratch.

The difficulty was a hundred, a thousand times higher than for those Evolvers who followed paths paved by pioneers.

Gathering his thoughts slowly, Lin Yuan got up and left the nutrition pod.

During the eighty years in the Dragon Tiger World, Lin Yuan was invincible,

but there were still many secrets he hadn’t unraveled.

For instance, the True Martial Sword, and the Primeval Demon Spirit.

Why had these items from the ‘Upper Realms’ fallen into the ‘Lower Realms’?

Could it be that the ‘Upper Realm’ powerhouses were laying out some plans?

But now that he had returned, none of this was relevant to Lin Yuan anymore.

“Two hours….”

Lin Yuan glanced at the time.

To confirm that from the moment he lay down for the traversal to the moment he got up, it took,

a total of two hours.

To be precise, it took two hours and three minutes.

“It seems that the tiers in the Dragon Tiger World are indeed higher than in the Martial World.”

Lin Yuan judged inwardly.

In the Martial World, twenty years passed and only ten minutes had gone by in the Main World.

If extended to eighty years, that would be forty minutes.

In terms of the flow of time, the rate in the Dragon Tiger World is less than half that of the Martial World.”

“There are also the powers of Taiyin and Taiyang on Canglan Star….”

Lin Yuan walked to the rooftop.

It was currently night, and Lin Yuan could distinctly feel the forces of Taiyin and Taiyang disseminating throughout the heavens and the earth.

Being nighttime, the Power of Taiyin was more pronounced than the Power of Taiyang.

“Absorbing it bit by bit is too slow, I still need to purchase corresponding ‘Spiritual Objects’.”

Lin Yuan sighed.

He now had the realm, what he lacked was merely energy accumulation.

And in the main world, what was least scarce was various forms of energy.

If Lin Yuan had the means, he could completely go cultivate on the surface of a star.

The Power of Taiyang there condenses into a liquid. With a single breath, the Taiyang power Lin Yuan could absorb would probably match years of arduous cultivation.

Of course, achieving this would require a substantial amount of money.

And Lin Yuan, most of all, lacked money.

With sufficient funds, Lin Yuan could not only purchase various Spiritual Objects.

He could even buy many of the evolutionary paths of the Cosmic Human Alliance to simulate and perfect his own cultivation system.

“Continue uploading the Dao of Taiji.”

After pondering for a moment, Lin Yuan made up his mind.

The Cosmic Human Alliance encouraged its citizens to develop new evolutionary paths, and the three goddesses even gave certain resource preferences to this.

After the first traversal, Lin Yuan exchanged the Martial Path Evolutionary Path for five thousand Merit Points.

One thousand of those Merit Points had elevated his citizen level to Second Level, granting him many privileges and making him an undisputed privileged class on Canglan Star.

The Dao of Taiji, being a continuation of the Martial Tao Cultivation System created by Lin Yuan, if uploaded, would certainly prompt the Goddess of Wisdom to re-evaluate and thereby earn more subsequent Merit Points.

In the Cosmic Human Alliance, Merit Points are everything.

The prerequisite for acquiring Merit Points is to contribute to humanity, and there are undoubtedly many other ways to do this.

But for Lin Yuan, the quickest and simplest way was only one.

That was to upload the Dao of Taiji.

The three goddesses of the Cosmic Human Alliance are absolutely selfless, and there are no scenarios involving suppression or enslavement of citizens.

As long as the Dao of Taiji uploaded by Lin Yuan was valuable enough, it would receive the protection of the three goddesses.

As for whether other citizens could surpass Lin Yuan in cultivation after uploading the Dao of Taiji…

Even though the cultivation environment of the Cosmic Human Alliance far surpassed that of the Dragon Tiger World, it would still take others decades to reach the Heavenly Master level on the Martial Path Evolutionary Path.

In a matter of decades… Given Lin Yuan’s shuttling frequency of once every eight months, he would have already experienced dozens of shuttles.

To the Heavenly Master of today, Lin Yuan of several decades later would hardly be considered anything less than an ant.

Since he decided to upload the Dao of Taiji.

Lin Yuan began to translate it into the language of the Main World and made minor adjustments.

Several days later.

Lin Yuan organized his achievements in the Dragon Tiger World into two parts.

The Celestial Phenomena Chapter and the Yin Yang Chapter.

The Yin Yang Chapter, indeed named by Lin Yuan for the Heavenly Master level.

To master both Taiyin and Taiyang, to integrate Taiyin and Taiyang.

After completing these tasks.

He immediately connected his consciousness to the Goddess of Wisdom.

If he were an ordinary citizen, even connecting to a trivial sub-entity of the Goddess of Wisdom,

would require patiently waiting for several minutes.

But Lin Yuan was a Second Level citizen who had made contributions to the Human Alliance.

It only took a moment.

The solemn and calm voice of the Goddess of Wisdom came through.

“Respected Second Level Citizen Lin Yuan, please state your request.”

“I want to continue uploading on the Martial Path Evolutionary Path,” Lin Yuan directly said.

After notifying the Goddess of Wisdom, Lin Yuan uploaded the organized “Celestial Phenomena Chapter” and “Yin Yang Chapter.”

The moment the Goddess of Wisdom received the “Celestial Phenomena Chapter” and “Yin Yang Chapter.”

In a mysterious space countless light-years away from Canglan Star,

numerous large screens flashed rapidly, and massive computational power frenziedly assessed and deduced the value of the “Celestial Phenomena Chapter” and “Yin Yang Chapter.”

“Detection of ‘Celestial Phenomena Chapter’ involving dual properties of Yin and Yang, detection of ‘Yin Yang Chapter’ involving the integration of dual properties of Yin and Yang… Extreme power integration, this evolutionary path’s theoretical limit is determined as ‘Sixth Rank.’”

“Discovery of potential up to the ‘Sixth Rank’ evolutionary path, triggering the ninth charter, commencing contact with the Goddess of Justice… commencing contact with the Goddess of Freedom…”

“Upon confirmation by the three goddesses, this evolutionary path indeed has the potential to reach ‘Sixth Rank.’”

“Relevant contingency plan generated, beginning to contact the highest authority of this planet, Planetary Governor Song Wuyang…”

At the highest point of Canglan Star,

Governor Song Wuyang had ended his calls with other planetary officials.

“The planetary tournament is about to begin. I hope this tournament yields a few seeds with the potential of Third or Fourth Rank.”

Song Wuyang sighed.

As the Planetary Governor, he too faced ‘performance’ pressures.

Every ten years, the Goddess of Wisdom would review every action taken during his governance, no matter how trivial.

Among the criteria were how many evolvers of different ranks were born on Canglan Star during this period and the overall happiness index of all citizens, among others.

The higher the Goddess of Wisdom’s evaluation of him, the greater his rewards, most tangibly in the form of Merit Points.

Of course, if the Goddess of Wisdom rated him too low,

he would not only fail to earn any Merit Points but would also face ‘impeachment,’

and in severe cases, he would lose his position as governor and be sent to the Supreme Court for trial.

“I wonder how the creator of that Martial Path Evolutionary Path is doing now?”

Thinking of the tournament, Song Wuyang naturally thought of Lin Yuan.

After all, the Martial Arts Evolution System had squeezed into the top hundred of Canglan Star’s evolution rankings as soon as it appeared.

This was the first change in the rankings during Song Wuyang’s term.

“The Goddess of Wisdom really protects these creators of evolutionary paths tightly. Even I, the governor, can’t access their information…”

Song Wuyang clicked his tongue.

Ordinary Second Level citizens were open to his scrutiny as much as he pleased, after all, he was a Fourth Level citizen.

However, Lin Yuan was not only a Second Level citizen but also a creator of an evolutionary path, making him a special person protected specifically by the Goddess of Wisdom.

But Song Wuyang also understood such actions by the Goddess of Wisdom.

In the history of the Cosmic Human Alliance, there had been many instances where promising talents were prematurely eliminated.

These eliminations arose from various sources: rivals, competitors, or Different Species.

Thus, the three goddesses decided that anyone identified as a ‘genius’ of the Human Race would be protected with specific encrypted information.

Outsiders couldn’t access their information at all, naturally making it very difficult to carry out any eliminations.

“It’s just that the Martial Arts Evolution System, having a potential upper limit of Third Rank, wouldn’t be valued so highly by the goddess if it wasn’t so widely adopted…”

Song Wuyang shook his head slightly.

Evaluating the value of a particular evolutionary path, potential is one aspect, and its degree of adoption is another.

Suddenly.

Just then.

An electronic synthesized voice came.

“Governor Song Wuyang, the Goddess of Wisdom requests a connection.”

“The Goddess of Wisdom wants to speak with me?” Song Wuyang was slightly startled.

He had just been thinking about the Goddess of Wisdom when she sought him out.

“Connect her.”

Song Wuyang nodded.

He straightened up his back a bit, wanting to appear more presentable to the Goddess of Wisdom.

After all, although Song Wuyang couldn’t see the Goddess of Wisdom, through various monitoring equipment, she could always keep track of all his movements.

As Song Wuyang chose to ‘connect’ with the Goddess of Wisdom.

“The Goddess of Wisdom has been connected…”

“The Goddess of Freedom has been connected…”

“The Goddess of Justice has been connected…”

In an instant, the three ultimate intelligent goddesses of the Cosmic Human Alliance all arrived.

This made Song Wuyang, who had been pondering how to speak with the Goddess of Wisdom, feel his scalp tingle.

Wasn’t it the Goddess of Wisdom who wanted to talk to him?

Why did all three goddesses show up?

Good heavens?

What on earth had happened to draw the attention of all three goddesses at once?
